Control: Identity is SHA-256 of exact file bytes
Description: The identity of a Canonical Record file is the SHA-256 of its exact bytes including the final LF. No parsing or re-serialization is involved.
ExpectedResult: Any byte change yields a different digest

Description: Record bytes must be valid UTF-8 and must not start with a byte order mark.
The top-level value must be followed by exactly one LF (0x0A) and nothing else.
No whitespace outside string literals; whitespace inside strings is data.
The file is exactly one RFC 8259 JSON value; no object has a repeated member name at any depth.
Top-level members are exactly intent, event, observe, meta, invariant in that order.
ExpectedResult: Reject with INVARIANT_REMOVED, MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD, UNEXPECTED_FIELD or FIELD_ORDER_VIOLATION

Description: Records validate against the unmodified F.1 schemas/canonical-record.schema.json.
1, 1.0 and 1e0 are distinct records; numbers are never normalized.

Control: No hash or version fields inside v1 records
Description: record_hash, contract_version, schema_version and record_version are not allowed in v1 records.
Verification and replay read bytes only; they never write to or rewrite record or sidecar files.
ExpectedResult: Fixture bytes and mtimes unchanged after a full audit run

Description: When several reasons apply, the one with the lowest precedence number in spec/rejection-reasons.json is reported.
ExpectedResult: Same input always yields the same code
